responsibility: Provides the primary compile-time target description for Alpha: predefined CPP builtins, processor and FP-mode enums shared with the backend, ABI-selection macros, storage-layout and mode properties, register naming, assembler syntax macros, debugger offset conventions, default option specs, and numerous target-wide constants that shape GCC’s generic code generator for this architecture. It is the central header that defines stable machine characteristics and baseline ABI behavior for all Alpha subtargets.
same_name_distinction: Header member of the Alpha stem: it provides compile-time target macros, enums, ABI/layout constants, and assembler/debugging definitions shared across the backend, rather than the runtime hook implementations in alpha.cc, the RTL pattern database in alpha.md, or the option table entries in alpha.opt.
